newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: PRESS DIGEST - Bangladesh Newspapers - Nov 25.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Bangladesh Newspapers - Nov 25.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Bangladesh press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
The opposition Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP) has drawn up a massive programme aimed at projecting the "political persecution" by the Awami League government.
The government has decided in principle to offload 25 percent shares of Biman, the Bangladesh national flag carrier, in the market soon to gear up its business.

The government is considering a proposal to have some arangement between the Bangladesh Bank and the Securities Exchange Commission to avoid overlapping of functions on dealing with financial institutions'
Fresh drilling in the newly discovered offshore gas field in the Bay of Bengal will start from next month.
Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina directed forest officials on Sunday to launch massive afforestation programmes on newly emerged chars and shouls for reclaiming land and creating greenery.
Fresh drives are being initiated by tribal leaders and influential community members to shake off the two decades old insurgency in Chittagong Hill Tracts.
Eight foreign industrial units in the Chittagong Export Processing Zone may go into operation by December this year, according to CEPZ sources.
A Singaporean delegation comprising businessmen interested to invest in Bangladesh will soon visit Dhaka to finalise their prospective investment.
